notes.slot_15_runeforge: Slot 15 (main hand) carries Rune of the Fallen Crusader, SpellItemEnchantment 3368, taken from the pinned preset's main-hand enchant. It is the item state that a Death Knight's native Runeforging spell 53344 leaves behind: SPELL_EFFECT_ENCHANT_ITEM (53) with misc value 3368, written to PERM_ENCHANTMENT_SLOT, which is enchantment field 0. The overlay writes that same field, so the only difference is that the character does not click the runeforge. The enchant is a combat-spell proc of 53365 Unholy Strength (+15% total Strength for 15 sec, plus a 3% heal). SpellItemEnchantment gives RequiredSkillID 776 (Runeforging), a Death Knight class skill, so profession resolution skips it and it takes neither of the two primary-profession slots.
